home.hero.lead: A shared corpus of words, pronunciations and usage from the Mayan, Xinka and Garifuna communities of Guatemala — open to read, open to download, and built to train models that finally sound like the people who spoke these words first.
home.image.alt: Presentation image for the Native Languages corpus
home.languages.title: Choose a language
home.languages.subtitle: Pick a language to narrow the search, or stay on all of them. Selecting a card below filters the words immediately.
home.words.title: Search the corpus
home.words.subtitle: Search a word in its own language, in translation, or both. Searching is open to everyone — no account needed.
home.words.placeholder: Search a word or its translation — try “jun” or “water”
home.contribute.title: Add what you know
home.contribute.subtitle: A word is only safe when several people agree on it. Contributors record the pronunciation they were taught, the situations it is used in, and review what others have added.
home.footer.tagline: Native Languages — a corpus for the languages of Guatemala.
home.footer.apiNote: Corpus loaded from the API. Entries marked pending are awaiting community review.
home.footer.fixtureNote: Sample entries are placeholders and are not yet verified by speakers.
home.notice.apiUnavailable: The corpus API is unavailable right now — showing the bundled sample data.
home.notice.signedIn: Signed in. Your session refreshes while you are active and expires after 30 minutes of inactivity.
search.placeholder: Search a word or its translation — try “jun” or “water”
search.aria: Search the corpus by word or translation
wordList.emptySearchText: Nothing in this selection contains “{query}”. Try a shorter fragment, or switch the scope to “All”.
wordList.emptyLanguageText: This language has no entries yet. Contributions from its speakers are what build the corpus.
download.title: Download these words
download.jsonHint: Full records, nested under a meta header
download.txtPairsHint: One word per line, tab separated
download.empty: Nothing to export in this selection.
download.noteSelection: Exports the {count} {word} currently shown that you ticked.
login.asideTitle.signup: Help a language outlive its last speaker.
login.asideText.signup: Contributors record pronunciations, usage examples and community review. Everything you add is reviewed before it becomes training data.
login.asideText.signin: Your drafts, reviews and the languages you follow are waiting for you.
login.perk.record: Record words with pronunciation and usage notes
login.perk.review: Review entries submitted by your community
login.perk.download: Download any language as JSON or TXT
login.subtitle.signup: It takes a minute, and the corpus needs people like you.
login.name: Name
login.fineprint: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt on the server. Sessions last 30 minutes and refresh while you are active.
login.error.name: Please enter the name that will appear on your contributions.
login.error.email: Please enter a valid email address.
login.error.password: Your password needs at least 8 characters.
login.dialog.descSignup: Create an account to contribute words and languages to the corpus.
login.dialog.descSignin: Sign in to contribute, review and manage the corpus.
loginPage.roleNote: Your role is {role}. The session refreshes while you are active and expires after 30 minutes of inactivity.
loginPage.newHere: New here? Accounts are reviewed before they can contribute.
loginPage.already: Already approved? Use your email and password to sign in.
role.signInText: This area is for approved contributors, reviewers and administrators. Public reading and downloads never require an account.
role.pending: Your account is waiting for admin approval.
role.wrongRoleTitle: This desk is not open to your role
role.wrongRoleText: You are signed in as {role}. Ask an admin if you need a different role.
contribute.title: Add and manage your entries
contribute.subtitle: Create words and languages, keep private drafts, submit them for review, and restore anything you discard before submitting.
contribute.hint.reviewer: Reviewer saves still need an admin's final approval before they publish.
contribute.hint.contributor: Your drafts stay private until you submit them for review.
contribute.empty: Nothing here yet. Create a language first if you are starting from scratch, then add words to it.
contribute.trashEmpty: Your private trash is empty. Deleting a draft moves it here instead of destroying it.
contribute.notice.deleted: Draft moved to your private trash. You can restore it any time.
contribute.confirmDelete: Move this draft to your private trash? You can restore it any time.
contribute.card.submittedHint: Submitted entries can only be removed through the review desk.
form.createLanguageFirst: Create a language first, then come back to add words to it.
form.usagePlaceholder: A sentence, a context, or a note for reviewers.
form.name: Name
form.hint.admin: Admin saves keep the current review state; new entries publish immediately.
form.hint.reviewer: Reviewer saves mark the entry reviewer approved; an admin still gives the final approval.
form.hint.contributorEdit: Editing a draft keeps it private; editing submitted content returns it to pending.
form.hint.contributorNew: Save first, then submit it to the reviewer queue when you are ready.
form.error.name: Enter a language name.
form.error.speakers: Speakers must be zero or more.
form.translations.title: Translations
form.translations.hint: Add or update this word's meaning in any active language. English is the canonical fallback.
form.translations.englishHint: Edit the English translation with the main Translation field above.
review.title: Moderate the corpus
review.subtitle: Review submitted words and languages, recommend approval or rejection, and raise removal requests. An admin gives the final approval.
review.hint.admin: You have the final say: approvals publish immediately, and removal requests become archive entries.
review.hint.reviewer: You can recommend approval, reject entries, and raise or withdraw removal requests. An admin makes the final decision.
review.empty: The queue is clear. New submissions will appear here after contributors send them for review.
review.card.removalOpen: A removal request is open for this entry
review.card.noteLabel: Reviewer note (optional for approval, useful for a rejection)
review.card.notePlaceholder: Say what is correct, or what the contributor should change.
review.card.recommendHint: Your approval is a recommendation; an admin still makes the final call.
review.card.approveRemovalHint: Approving is a logical delete; the entry moves to the admin archive.
review.notice.final: Final approval saved. The entry is published.
review.notice.recommend: Recommendation saved. An admin still needs to give the final approval.
review.notice.rejected: Entry rejected and returned to its author.
review.notice.removed: Entry removed logically and kept in the admin archive.
review.notice.requestRejected: Removal request rejected. The entry stays as it is.
review.notice.savedAdmin: The current review state was kept.
review.notice.savedReviewer: It is now marked as reviewer approved and still needs an admin's final approval.
review.confirmRemove: Remove "{title}" logically? It will move to the admin archive and can be restored later.
review.error.load: Could not load the review queue.
review.error.clear: Could not clear that removal request.
admin.title: Accounts, approvals and the archive
admin.subtitle: Approve new contributors and reviewers, manage active accounts, and keep removed content retained but hidden from the public corpus.
admin.notice.accounts: New accounts cannot sign in until you approve them. Deactivation takes effect on the next API request, even for an open session.
admin.notice.content: Browse published content, fix entries directly, or remove something logically. Removed content moves to the archive and can be restored.
admin.notice.presentation: The home presentation image is public. Uploads replace the current file for every visitor; removing it falls back to the NL mark.
admin.notice.pageText: Edit the copy shown across the public pages and dashboards in English and Spanish. Unchanged fields keep the bundled default.
admin.notice.archive: Removed words and languages stay here instead of being destroyed. The audit log keeps the full snapshot and removal date.
admin.loadError: Could not load the admin data.
admin.accounts.selfHint: Your own role and status cannot be changed from this screen.
admin.accounts.reactivateHint: The account returns with its previous {role} role; change the role afterwards if needed.
admin.accounts.deactivatedNotice: {name} deactivated. Existing sessions stop working immediately.
admin.accounts.rejectPrompt: Reason for rejecting {name}? This is shown to the account owner.
admin.content.none: No published content yet. Use the contribution desk to create a word or language; admin saves publish immediately.
admin.content.removeHint: Removing hides it from the public corpus and moves it to the archive.
admin.content.removePrompt: Reason for removing "{title}"? It will be kept in the archive with this note.
admin.content.removedNotice: Entry removed logically and moved to the archive.
admin.content.restoredNotice: Entry restored to the review queue as pending.
admin.content.savedNotice: {kind} {action}. Admin edits keep the current review state.
admin.archive.none: Nothing has been removed yet. Logically deleted content will appear here for review and restoration.
admin.archive.hint: Restored content returns as pending and needs a final approval again.
siteImage.title: Home presentation image
siteImage.description: This is the large image beside the home page introduction. Uploading a new file replaces the current one for every visitor.
siteImage.noImage: No image yet. The home page is using the NL mark as a fallback.

siteImage.altPlaceholder: A short description for screen readers
siteImage.altHelp: {count}/200 · Describe what the image shows, not the file name.
siteImage.confirmRemove: Remove the home presentation image? The home page will fall back to the NL mark until an admin uploads another image.
siteImage.error.type: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
siteImage.error.size: That image is larger than 5 MB.
siteImage.error.load: Could not load the home image.
siteImage.error.save: Could not save the home image.
siteImage.error.remove: Could not remove the home image.
siteImage.notice.replaced: Home image replaced. Every visitor now sees the new image.
pageContent.title: Page text
pageContent.description: Edit the copy shown on the public pages and dashboards. Changes are stored as overrides; the bundled English and Spanish files remain the defaults.
pageContent.noKeys: No editable keys were found for this language.
pageContent.error.load: Could not load the page text.
pageContent.error.save: Could not save the page text.
pageContent.noMatch: No page-text keys match that filter.
pageContent.confirmResetAll: Reset every override for {locale}? All copy returns to the bundled defaults.
